onboarding.title: Tracking setup
onboarding.intro: Follow these steps once. Each step tells you why it is needed and what to tap.
onboarding.readyText: You can now start your day.
onboarding.notNeededHere: This step is not needed on this device.

consent.title: Welcome and consent
consent.why: We need your clear agreement before tracking your location.
consent.what: Your location (GPS), battery level and whether the phone settings needed for tracking are on.
consent.when: Only between "Start my day" and "End my day". Nothing is tracked outside your working day.
consent.who: Your supervisor and the managers above you see your current location, your route during the day and your visits.
consent.fake: Fake GPS apps and changed locations are detected and reported to your supervisor.
consent.checkbox: I agree to share my location during my working day.

locationWhileInUse.title: Location permission
locationWhileInUse.why: The app needs your location to record your working day and verify your visits.
locationWhileInUse.instructions: Tap the button below. When the phone asks, choose "While using the app".

locationAlways.title: Location all the time
locationAlways.why: So your day keeps being recorded when the phone is locked or the app is in the background.
locationAlways.instructions: Tap the button. In the screen that opens, tap "Permissions", then "Location", then choose "Allow all the time". Also turn on "Use precise location".
locationAlways.guideWhileUsing: Allow only while using the app

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.why: Android shows a small notification while your day is running, and your supervisor can ask the app for a fresh location.

locationServices.title: Turn on phone location
locationServices.why: Without phone location (GPS) no position can be recorded.
locationServices.instructions: Open the location settings and turn "Use location" on. If you see "Location accuracy" or "Improve accuracy", turn it on too.

battery.title: Battery settings
battery.why: Phones close apps to save battery. That stops tracking in the middle of your day.
battery.instructions: Tap the button and choose "Allow" so the app is not limited. Then follow the steps for your phone below.

mockLocation.title: No fake location
mockLocation.why: Fake location apps are detected and reported. Your location must come from the real GPS.
mockLocation.instructions: Make sure no fake GPS app is open. If Developer options are on, open them and set "Select mock location app" to "Nothing".
mockLocation.clean: Your location comes from the real GPS.
mockLocation.detected: A fake location app is active. Turn it off and check again.
mockLocation.unknown: Could not check. Make sure location is on and try again.

healthCheck.title: Final check
healthCheck.why: We check every step again and send a test location to the server.
healthCheck.instructions: Tap the button and wait a few seconds.
healthCheck.serverOk: A test location reached the server
healthCheck.serverFailed: The test location did not reach the server. Check your internet and try again.

samsung.name: Samsung
steps: Settings > Apps > Original Pharma > Battery: choose "Unrestricted".
Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Sleeping apps: remove Original Pharma if it is listed.
In the same screen open "Never sleeping apps" and add Original Pharma.

xiaomi.name: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO
steps: Settings > Apps > Manage apps > Original Pharma: turn "Autostart" on.
In the same screen open "Battery saver" and choose "No restrictions".
Open recent apps, press and hold Original Pharma, and tap the lock icon so it is not closed.

oppo.name: OPPO / realme / OnePlus
steps: Settings > Apps > App management > Original Pharma: turn "Auto launch" (or "Allow auto launch") on.
Battery usage: turn "Allow background activity" on.
Battery optimization: set Original Pharma to "Don't optimize".

huawei.name: Huawei / Honor
steps: Settings > Battery > App launch > Original Pharma: switch to "Manage manually".
Turn on all three: "Auto-launch", "Secondary launch" and "Run in background".

vivo.name: vivo / iQOO
steps: Settings > Battery > Background power consumption management: choose "Allow high background power consumption" for Original Pharma.
Settings > Apps > Autostart: turn Original Pharma on.

generic.name: Your phone
steps: Settings > Apps > Original Pharma > Battery: choose "Unrestricted" or "Don't optimize".
If your phone has an "Autostart" or "Auto launch" setting, turn it on for Original Pharma.
Do not close the app from the recent apps screen during your day.

adminSettings.title: Settings
adminSettings.hint: System settings stored on the server. Changes apply to new data within a minute.

locationTrust.title: Location trust
locationTrust.description: How strictly locations and visits are checked for fake GPS and impossible movement. A rep is never blocked: suspicious data is kept and shown for review.

policies.flagOnlyHint: Fake locations are marked and raised for review, and still count in distance and attendance.
policies.flagAndExcludeHint: Fake locations are marked and raised for review, and left out of the distance travelled and of visits counted in statistics.

hints.maxSpeedKmh: Faster movement between two locations is physically impossible: the point is rejected (kept, never counted).
hints.maxDistanceFromDoctorMeters: A check-in or check-out further away than this is flagged "far from the doctor".
hints.accuracyAllowanceMeters: Up to this much of the reported accuracy is added to the allowed distance, so a weak signal does not count against the rep.
hints.lowTrustAccuracyMeters: Visit locations less accurate than this are marked as weak evidence.
hints.perfectAccuracyMeters: Real phones rarely report better than 3 m; fake GPS apps often report 0 to 1 m.
hints.repeatedAccuracyRun: This many locations in a row with exactly the same accuracy look generated.
hints.deviceSignalsRetentionDays: Phone settings saved with each location (developer options, fake GPS apps, root) are deleted after this many days.
